message: As a grandparent, I often find myself playing the role of the wise guide, especially when it comes to preparing for the unexpected. I recently stumbled upon a fantastic resource that helps us all understand what to include in an emergency kit. It’s not just for us adults! Involving the kids in this process can be a fun way to teach them about responsibility and teamwork. After all, a little preparation can turn a potentially stressful situation into a family adventure. How do you involve your little ones in safety planning?
